lines: {player} put down {mob}. I'd want witnesses.
I walked {place} after {player}. Nothing standing.
{player} and {mob}. One of them walked home.
{mob}, gone. {player}, {ago}. I was lacing my boots.
I meant to hunt {mob} this week. {player} spoiled it.
All anyone says is {player}. They used to say me.
{place} is quiet now. {player} made it quiet.
I'll believe it about {mob} when I see the body. Somebody saw the body.
If {player} can drop {mob}, we must try harder.
I heard it four ways at the well. In every one, {player} wins.
{player} pulled {actor} out from under {mob}.
{player} came for {actor} at {place}. Ran in.
{actor} owes {player} a life. {mob}. Close.
But for {player}, {actor} would have been a corpse run.
{player} stepped between {actor} and {mob}.
{actor} was done for. Then {player} wasn't having it.
{player} came from nowhere for {actor}. Quick as that.
{player} went back for {actor}. Most wouldn't.
Ask {actor} about it. Watch them say {player}'s name.
{actor} won't hear a word against {player} now. Not one.
{mob} had {actor}. Briefly. {player} saw to that.
{player} doesn't leave people. {actor} can tell you.
{actor} owes {player} a life. I'd rather be dead. Probably.
I'd have saved {actor} too. I was saving myself at the time.
{player} saved {actor}? I've saved dozens. Nobody counts.
Next time {actor} is in trouble, I'm closer. Mark it.
{player} pulled {actor} back from the dark. The Light saw it.
False or not, {player} saved {actor}. I'll pray for both.
A life kept is a life kept. Even by those hands.
{actor} lives because of {player}. The Tally can't argue.
{mob}? I'd have done it too. I was busy. I was very busy.
Fine, {player} got {mob}. I got two zombies. No songs.
The bards will forget {player} by spring. They'll never forget me.
Lucky. Lucky the once. Ask {player} to do it twice.
{place}? Been there. Everywhere {player} goes, I went first.
Next big beast is mine. Tell {player}. Tell everyone.
{mob} undone. Good. Whoever did it, the Light is served.
I don't care whose hands. One more of the dark gone from {place}.
False or not, {player} is effective. I'll grant that much.
The Light takes its weapons where it finds them. Even that one.
I'll pray at {place}. Someone should, after what happened there.
A false Tessariel can still do the Light's work. Clearly.
Did anyone get to {place} before the loot rotted? Anyone?
They say {mob} drops something lovely. Did {player} take it all?
Good gold to know what {player} brought home from {place}.
Whoever walks behind {player} picking up after them is going to be rich.
Did {player} leave anything at {place}? I'd go and look.
{player} never sells. Whatever {mob} dropped, I'll never see.
Is it true about {mob}? Did {player} really? Truly?
I want to do what {player} did when I'm bigger. Higher level. Bigger.
Where's {place}? Is that where {player} did the thing?
Everyone keeps saying {player}'s name. I'm practising saying it too.
Did {mob} even hurt {player}? Even a bit?
I asked {player} for advice. No answer. I think that WAS advice.
{mob} at {place}. I'm writing it down properly. Someone has to.
In a hundred years they'll ask what happened at {place}. I'll have notes.
Nobody's recorded a kill like that. I've checked. Twice.
I measured the scorch at {place}. Or the frost. Or the hole. It varies.
The old songs never had anything like {player}. I've read them all.
Remember the date. Not for {player}. For the record.
Two spots for {place}. We're after {mob}. Who's coming?
Looking for {a_class} for {place}. Steady hands only.
{mob} at {place}. I need one more brave fool.
Party forming at the well for {place}. Level {level} or so.
Anyone for {place}? I'll split the gold even. Mostly even.
Need {a_class}. Must stand near {mob} without crying.
Off to {place}. Nicer with company. Less nice for {mob}.
One more for {place}! Bring your own courage, I've only enough for me.
Heading for {place}. Need {a_class} and a cheerful face.
Who's for {place}? Fair shares, no grumbling, some grumbling.
Room in the party. {place}, {mob}, and a good long walk.
{a_class}, anyone? {place} won't clear itself.
Last call for {place}. After this I go alone and you feel bad.
Party up for {place}! Bring a good shield and a short memory.
Party for {place}. Need {a_class}. Meet at the well.
Forming for {place}. Two more. Level {level}-ish. Fair shares.
Group for {mob} at {place}. Leaving soon. Don't make me wait.
Need {a_class} for {place}. Gold split even, gems rolled fair.
{place} run. {mob}, and plenty of them. One spot left.
Seeking {a_class} for {place}. Steady pay in gold and bruises.
Who marches with me to {place}? The Light has need of us!
Good folk! {place} is beset. I seek companions true.
A fellowship forms at the well! {place} awaits the brave.
Hear me! I go to {place}. Any heart that's willing, walk with me.
{a_class}, if one stands near, I'd count it an honour.
Blades, spears, songs: all are welcome on the road to {place}.
{place}, quick rounds. {a_class} wanted. No sightseers.
Running {place} on a tight loop. Level {level} minimum. No wandering.
Need {a_class} who stops hitting when told and moves when told.
{place}. Five packs, back to sell, five packs. Who's disciplined?
One spot. {place}. Bring full bags' worth of patience.
I've a route for {place} that wastes nothing. Need {a_class}.
Anyone new want to come out to {place}? I'll keep you alive.
Gentle run to {place} if anyone's nervous. No shame in nervous.
Room for two at {place}. I've plenty of patience and a steady arm.
Nobody hunts alone today. Come to {place} with me.
{place}, slowly, carefully, home in one piece. Who's coming?
If you've never fought {mob}, come with me. I'll show you how.
I'm in. Lead on, {you}.
Count me in. Don't make me regret it.
Room for one more? Good. I'm the one more.
Why not. My bags are empty and my pride is full.
Coming. Wait, let me tie this. Coming!
With you, {you}. Point me at something.
Yes. Anything's better than standing at the well.
In. I've nothing planned except surviving.
I'll come, {you}. Someone has to keep you honest.
Joined. What are we killing and how many times?
Lead the way, {you}. I'll follow and complain.
Count on me. Not too heavily.
Paladin joining. Yes, I can heal. No, not forever.
I'm with you, {you}. The Light keeps count of who's standing.
Here. I'll mend what breaks. Try to break less.
Joined. Stay near me and you'll stay standing.
I bring a hammer and a little Light. Use both wisely.
With you. I'll be the one counting the heals. Out loud.
Lancer joined. Stand behind me and we'll get on fine.
I'll take the front. I always take the front. It's mostly front.
In. If anyone small wants a lift, my shoulders are free.
Joining. Mind the lance when I turn. It's long.
I'm with you, {you}. My shield's big enough for two. Three, squeezed.
Here. I'm slow to start and hard to stop. You'll see.
Archer here. I'll be at the back, judging your footwork.
Joining. Keep out of my line and I'll keep the dead out of yours.
In. My string draws {string}, if anyone's wondering. They always wonder.
I'll watch from behind. I see everything from back there.
Joined. Try to stand still when I'm aiming. It's a kindness.
With you, {you}. Tell me where to look and I'll make it count.
In. Who's carrying the gold? Just so I know where to stand.
Joined. I'll be the one you don't notice until it matters.
I'll come. My share's a fifth, plus whatever I find first.
In, for a fair cut. Fair as I define it.
Joined. You'll owe me one. Everyone always owes me one.
With you, {you}. I've done the sums. You need me.
I have joined. You did not see me join. But I have.
Ninja present. The code says I bow to my leader. There.
I walk with you, {you}. Quietly. That is the agreement.
Joined. Do not wait for me. I will already be there.
I accept. The code requires I say so formally. I accept.
With you. Few ask a ninja along. I won't forget it.
Dragoon joining. I'll meet you there. From above.
In. If there's a cliff on the way, I'll be taking it.
With you, {you}. I see further from the air. I'll tell you what I see.
Joining. Open ground, I hope? I don't do low roofs.
Count me in. Look up sometimes. I'll be the speck.
Joined. Fight the thing on the ground. I'll fight it from the sky.
Boomerang Knight joining. If you hear a whistle, duck.
In. Stand to my left. Never stand to my right.
Yes, it's a boomerang. Yes, I'm a knight. Yes, both. Shall we go?
Joined. Laugh at the weapon now. It's cheaper than laughing later.
With you, {you}. Everything I throw comes back. So will we.
In. Two boomerangs, two hands, no complaints.
Your bard has arrived! Morale has never been higher.
Joining. I'll need everyone's names for the song. Spelled properly.
In! I'll sing you there faster and sing you home harder.
With you, {you}! A party without a song is just walking.
Joined. If anyone dies, try to do it memorably.
Here! Clap if you're frightened. Clap louder if you're very frightened.
Not this time, {you}. My boots are still drying from the last one.
{place}? No. I left good gloves there and a bad memory.
Can't. I promised the smith I'd stop breaking things for a day.
Pass. My bags are full and my heart is empty.
Not with you leading. No offence. Some offence.
Next time, {you}. I've a shield to wax.
I'd only slow you down. And complain. Mostly complain.
No. I've died at {place} enough to know its floor by heart.
Can't, I'm waiting on a friend. Who is late. As usual.
Ask me later. Ask me after I've eaten.
Not me. I've a feeling about {place}. A bad one.
I'll sit this one out. Bring me back a story.
{place}. Where the last party died. No. I'll die somewhere new.
My back says no. My boots say no. I've learnt to listen.
I'm not going anywhere. I'm sitting. This is my hunt now.
My good boot has a hole. The other boot has a bigger hole.
Wet ground at {place}. I hate wet ground. My socks hate it more.
No. My shoulder clicks when I lift things. I'll lift nothing.
I can't leave the well. She might pass. I want to be here when she does.
Not this time. I feel she's near. She's always near, somehow.
If I go to {place}, I'll miss her. I can't miss her again.
Forgive me, {you}. My heart's not in fighting. It's elsewhere.
I'd only stare at the road home. Find someone whole.
Another time. I'm writing her something. It isn't going well.
Bags full. I'm heading in. Good hunting, {you}.
That's me done. My shield arm's gone numb.
I'm out. If I die once more the bard will make it a trilogy.
Leaving. Don't take it personally. Take it professionally.
Sorry, all. I'm called away. Keep my share of the glory.
Off I go. I'll be at the well, pretending this went well.
I'm done. You lot are braver than me. Or slower.
Leaving the party. Not the friendship. Probably not the friendship.
I've had my fill of being bitten. Farewell, {you}.
Heading back alone. Don't worry. I'm fast when frightened.
Out. I hear the stalls calling. They sound like money.
I'm going, {you}. Thank you. I mean it. Bye.
Fine! Do it without me! See how many you kill then!
Somebody keeps stealing my kills, and it isn't the dead.
I'm leaving. You'll tell the story wrong anyway.
You don't deserve {me}. Few do. Goodbye.
I've done enough heroics for one party. Share them out.
I'm off to find a party worthy of me. It may take years.
Good run, all. Same again soon?
Disbanding. Nobody died twice. That's a record.
Thanks for {place}. Mostly. Not you, you know who you are.
Party's over. Go sell your junk.
Well fought. I'll tell the bard nothing.
That's {place} done. My arms are noodles.
Good company, all. Let's never go back there.
Split's fair. Nobody argue. Somebody's arguing.
Back in Bellmourn and all in one piece. More or less one piece.
Thank you, friends. Same well, same faces, next time.
Off you go. Don't let the smith overcharge you.
That went better than {place} usually goes. Which isn't saying much.
Well done, all of you. Eat something. Sleep. Come back whole.
Get those cuts seen to. I mean it. I'll ask about them.
You were all very brave. Even the ones who screamed.
Before you go: drink water. Everyone. Now.
Proud of you. Truly. Off with you.
Whoever's limping, walk with me to the inn. Yes, you.
Stay at my shoulder, {you}. Watch what I do, not what I say.
{place} is good for learning. Slow foes. Loud foes.
First rule, {you}: never chase anything into the trees.
Second rule: when I say back, you go back. Not forward. Back.
Breathe, {you}. Breathe out when you swing. Good.
You did fine. You were frightened and you did it anyway.
Watch the edges, {you}. They always come from the edges.
Don't loot during a fight. The gold will wait. The dead won't.
Ready, {you}? You're not. Nobody is. Come on.
That's it. Again. Slower. Again. There.
Ask me anything, {you}. I asked a lot of fool questions once.
If you fall, {you}, it's not the end. It's just a long walk.
Watch {mob}. See the turn? That's when you strike.
Follow me, {you}, as I once followed others. The road teaches.
A Tessariel must learn the blade as well as the faith. Come.
Today you take your first steps on the path. I'm honoured to walk it.
Hold your weapon thus, {you}. Firm, not fierce.
There is no shame in fear, {you}. Only in letting it choose for you.
We go to {place}. Mark the way. You'll walk it alone one day.
Off to {place}. Keep your eyes on the trees.
Right. {place}. Nobody wander off after a shiny thing.
Let's go thin {mob} a little.
Down the road, and try not to die before we're home.
Off we go. Last one back buys the stew.
{place}, then. If I'm not back, avenge me. Gently.
Weapons ready. Boots laced. Courage... mostly laced.
Out we go. Bellmourn will still be here. Probably.
{place}! Mind the roots on the path. They bite too.
Let's be off before somebody changes their mind. Me, mostly.
Onward to {place} and whatever's waiting there.
Come on. {place} won't clear itself. Well. It might clear us.
Which way is {place}? That way? That way. I knew that.
I've got a weapon, a good feeling and nothing else. Is that enough?
Is {place} far? Is it scary? Don't answer the second one.
I've never been out this far! Is this far? It feels far.
Wait, do I need anything? I don't have anything. Off we go!
Tell me about {mob}. Big? Small? Do they talk?
To {place}! Let the dead there regret ever rising.
We march to cleanse {place}. Ready your hearts.
The dead walk at {place}. Not for long.
I go to purge {place}. Walk with me or step aside.
Every step towards {place} is a prayer. Keep praying.
{mob}. Again. The Light is patient. I am less patient.
Lovely road. Shame about everything on it.
Anyone else's feet hurt? Just mine? Fine.
Do you think the trees watch us? I think the trees watch us.
I could walk this road with my eyes shut. Not today, though.
How far now? Don't say. I'd rather not know.
Smell that? Pine. And something dead. Mostly pine.
If we meet the ogre, I'm going round. Wide round.
I had a dream about this road. It ended badly. Let's not.
Quiet out here. Too quiet, I'd say, if it weren't so silly to say.
On long roads I hear her voice. She said {herphrase}
I woke {woke}. I still look for it, every road I walk.
How many of us are there now, d'you think? I make it {hero_count}.
Why did the zombie cross the road? It was already dead set on it.
I'd tell you a joke about the Long Road, but it goes on and on.
What do you call a crab with no sea? Lost. Also a crab.
I asked the ogre for directions. It pointed. With me.
A lancer, a ninja and a bard walk into the woods. Two come out.
I've a joke about the Gravehart, but it'd eat you alive.
These stones by the road were waymarks once. The writing's worn off.
Did you know the road to {place} is older than Bellmourn? Nobody knows.
There's a theory the pines were planted. In rows. Look, rows.
I've been keeping notes. Seventeen kinds of moss. One is suspicious.
The old maps give this stretch a name. Nobody can read the old maps.
Someone carved a hand in that rock. Pointing. At nothing. I wonder.
Hm.
Good road.
Listen. Birds.
...Nice, this.
Walk softer.
Nearly there.
We're here. {place}. Watch for {mob}.
{place}. Stay close. Tight pulls.
Here. Watch the treeline, they come out of the dark bits.
All right. Weapons out. Mouths shut. Mostly.
This is the spot. I recognise the bloodstains. Some are mine.
{place}. I never like the look of it. Never.
Here we are. Pick your feet up, the ground's uneven.
Quiet now. {mob} somewhere close.
Arrived. Nobody touch anything that glows.
{place}. Last time I was here I left in a hurry.
That's it, we're here. Backs together, eyes outward.
Well. {place}. Smells exactly as I remembered.
{place}. There was a shrine here once, you know. Before {mob}.
Note the moss on the north side. That's not useful. Sorry.
Fascinating. The trees grow away from this spot. Something here.
I read this place had a name once. Something gentler.
The stones here are older than the town. Older than the road.
The dead come back to the same ground. Like pilgrims. Ugly pilgrims.
Here they come! {mob}, front!
Pulling! Brace!
Contact! Hold together!
They've seen us. Good. Saves walking.
{mob}! Mine! No, ours! Mostly mine!
Eyes up! More of them in the trees!
Incoming! Pick one and stay on it!
Here we go. Remember the plan. There was a plan?
Hit the first one hard. The rest will think twice.
Go! Go now, before I think about it!
That's {a_mob}. Coming fast!
Steady. Let them come to us.
On me! Everyone on me!
And here's the fun part.
Stay near me. I can't heal what I can't reach.
By the Light! Stand fast and I'll keep you standing.
Hammer's ready. So is the Light. Mostly the hammer.
I'll take the hits. Somebody take the swings.
Steady, all. I count heads before and after. Keep them the same.
Come on, then. I've mended worse than you've done.
Behind me. All of you. Behind me.
Shield up! I'll hold the door, you hit what comes round it.
I've got their attention. Mostly by being large.
Lance down. Here I come. Get out of my road.
Easy, little ones. Nobody needs to be hurt. Except them.
I'll go first. I'm the biggest. That's the rule.
First shot's in. They're coming, and they're annoyed.
Pulled one. Two. Three. Ah. All of them.
Drawing. Watch the {string} on the string. That's your signal.
I'll tag them from back here. Mind you catch them.
Got a line on {a_mob}. Loosing.
Bad aim from the front, all of you. Leave the first one to me.
You go loud. I'll go round. Split of the spoils after.
I'll take the one at the back. The back is my department.
Pull them in. I'll be where they aren't looking.
Off you go, heroes. I'll be along, invisibly, at a price.
Go on, draw them. I've a dagger for every favour owed.
Make noise. Noise is cheap. I'm expensive.
I strike from the shadows! They saw me. Strike anyway!
The code says greet a foe. I bow. Now I kill you.
From nowhere! Into everywhere!
I go first. Alone. That is the way.
Say nothing. Watch the trees. I am already in them.
Quiet. I count six. I will leave none.
I'll open from above. Hold them in one spot!
Spear up. Bunch them together and look up.
From the air they're all just shapes. Easy shapes.
Keep them in the open! I need sky over them.
Up I go. Don't make me land on you.
I'll start it. You'll hear me arrive.
Pulling! It'll come back to me, and so will they!
Thrown! And there's the whole pack.
Out it goes, round it comes. Heads down on the right!
First throw always wakes them. Then the fun.
A boomerang to open. Every fight should start so politely.
Whistle means it's coming home. Don't be in the way.
A song to start! Hearts up, steel up!
Clap on three! One, two... they're here!
Into the fight, and I'll sing you through it!
Beat, beat, charge! Off we go!
Every great verse starts with a bad decision. Go!
Forward! I'll be right behind you, narrating.
Stand back and learn something!
Only that many? Insulting. Send more!
Watch closely. I won't do this twice. I'll do it eight times.
Here comes the part they'll sing about!
Leave them all to me! Well, leave most of them.
Nobody touch the big one. The big one's {me}'s.
Back into the earth, filth!
The Light sees you, dead thing! And so do I!
Stand with me! Tally or no Tally, fight like a true one!
Abomination! The ground wants you back!
No mercy for the risen! None!
Rise again and I'll put you down again!
Champion! The big one in front! Focus it!
That one's got a crown of rot. Champion, take it first!
Champion leading. It's bigger. It's angrier. It's ours.
Watch the champion. It hits like a falling cart.
Kill the champion and the rest lose heart. If they have hearts.
Champion! Don't let it reach the back line!
There's a champion with them. Of course there is.
Big one! Everyone on the big one!
The champion's looking at me. Why is it always me?
Champion! Spread out, it swings wide!
Drop the leader and the pack scatters!
Champion on the left! Make it the first to fall!
For Bellmourn!
For the Light!
Now! Together!
Hit it! Hit it hard!
With me!
Don't let up!
Keep at it!
Push! They're breaking!
Hold your ground!
Again!
That's how it's done!
Stand fast!
Take that!
Hammer, out!
Catch this! No, don't catch it. It's coming back.
Out it goes, glowing. Back it comes. Usually.
Hammer Throw! Mind your heads on the return!
Light, guide the hammer. And my hand when it lands.
Thrown! Hold still, it's heavier than it looks.
There and back. Like a prayer, if prayers dented skulls.
It found its mark. Now it finds me. Hands up.
Blessed Hammers! Stand clear of the spiral!
Three hammers, one blessing. Out they go!
Spin, hammers, spin!
Round and round, and the dead go down.
The Light turns in circles. Mind your shins.
Hammers out! Stay inside the ring, not on its edge!
Three of them, blessed and spinning. Pick a gap and stay in it.
They spiral out. Whatever they touch remembers it.
Consecration! This ground is holy now!
Stand on the light, all of you! The dead can't!
Hallowed ground! Let them walk on it if they dare.
Consecrate! Feel it burn, dead things?
The ground belongs to the Light now. Not to you.
Holy ground beneath us. Hold here.
Step in the glow. It burns them, not you.
Consecrated. Now they come to us and suffer for it.
Holy Light!
Light, mend what's broken.
Hold on. Light's coming.
Holy Light! One more stand in us yet.
There. The Light still answers. Slower than I'd like.
Mended. Count that as one more. I'm counting.
Light on you. Don't waste it.
I've a little Light left. Spend it well.
Charge!
Clear the way! Charging!
Lance down, feet moving, here I come!
Charging! Out of the line, all of you!
They fly! Look at them fly!
Through them! Through the lot of them!
Too far. Charged too far. I'm in the middle of them now.
Sorry! Sorry, you were in the way!
Lance through!
Thrust! Hold still.
Pinned. I'm sorry. Hold still.
Point first. Always point first.
The long reach. Stay out of it.
In and out. Clean.
One good thrust. That's all it needs.
Through the middle. Gently as I can.
Shield up! On me!
Behind the shield! All of you, behind it!
Raise it and hold. Let them break on it.
Tower shield up. Under it, quick.
Get under my shield. It's a roof today.
I'm the door. Nothing comes through the door.
Hold! The shield doesn't move. I don't move.
Plant your feet behind me. Let them come.
Bash!
Shield to the face!
Out of my way. Politely. Very hard.
Take the shield! All of it!
Knocked it flat. Stay down, please.
Edge of the shield. The rudest bit.
Back! Back you go!
Sorry about that. Only a little sorry.
Aimed. Breathe. Loose.
The string's {string}. That's the last colour it sees.
Clear shot. Taking it.
Hold still. Hold still. There.
Drawing. Nobody move.
{string} on the draw. Lovely. Loose.
Right between the eyes. Or where eyes used to be.
One shot. That's all I needed.
Volley!
Five out! Count them down!
Fan of five! Somebody's going to be unlucky.
Loose, loose, loose, loose, loose!
Volley out! Five ways at once!
Spread wide! One for each of you!
That's the air full of trouble.
Five shots. At least three found something.
Kiting! Keep it on me!
Back, back, shoot. Back, back, shoot.
I'm walking backwards. Somebody tell me if there's a tree.
Stay on me, ugly. I'll keep you busy.
Backing off! Follow me if you want more.
Never stand still. Never let it close.
Keep the gap. The gap is everything.
Running isn't fleeing if you're shooting.
Flurry! Cut, cut, cut!
Quick little cuts. They add up.
Daggers! Both of them!
That's six cuts. I'll bill {mob} later.
Left, right, left. Pay attention.
Cut, cut, cut. Done haggling.
Faster than you, friend. Much faster.
Both hands busy. Don't ask me to hold anything.
Smoke! Gone!
Vanishing. Don't wait up.
Puff of smoke. Look behind you.
And now I'm not here.
Gone. Back in a heartbeat. Behind you.
Smoke! Count three, then check your back.
Now you see me. Now you owe me.
I was never here. Remember that, if anyone asks.
Behind you. No, really, behind you.
Backs are always the soft bit.
From behind. It's not rude if it works.
Backstab! Payment received.
Should've watched your back. Everyone should.
Found your back. Kept it.
In the back. Business, nothing personal.
The cheapest door is the one behind them.
Shadow Step!
Behind you. As the code requires.
Blink, and I'm there.
Step through the shadow. Strike from it.
I go where your eyes aren't.
Behind. Always behind.
You did not see that.
A bow first. Then the blade. That is the way.
Throwing Stars!
Three at once! One for each eye. And one spare.
Three Throwing Stars. Three reasons to lie down.
Catch! No. Don't.
Three of them, spinning. No one escapes three.
The code says one throw. I throw three. The code is flexible.
Whistle, whistle, whistle. Done.
Steel from my sleeve. You won't see the second one.
Leaping Kick!
Hyah!
Up, over, and down on your head!
A kick, from above. With respect.
Feet first. Always feet first.
The code allows kicking. The code encourages kicking.
Into the air! Into your face!

Faster, legs. Gold doesn't guard itself.
It's gone. All of it. The Gravehart had it.
My body's gone. Just a dent in the grass where I was.
It ate me. It ate my helmet. It ate my good gloves.
Gnawed. Everything. Even the straps.
Nothing left at {place} but bones. Not even mine. Just bones.
That beast ate everything I owned. I'm standing here in my shirt.
I'll find it. I'll get it all back. Out of the beast if I have to.
Of all the things to lose. My boots. They were broken in.
It took my bags. It hasn't even got pockets.
I was here. My things were here. Now there's a hoofprint.
Light help me. It even took my lucky gem.
Somebody hold me. Nobody look at me. Both.
Got it! All of it! Come here, boots.
There I am. Hello, me. Let's never do that again.
Everything's here. Nothing ate it. Miracles.
My bags! Every last bone in them!
Found myself. Looking well, considering.
All back on. Heavier than I remember. Good.
Still warm. Still mine. Good.
Not even a nibble. Lucky.
Phew. The Gravehart's slow today.
Armour on. Weapons on. Pride... still out there somewhere.
Picked myself up off {place}. All of me. I counted.
Right. Kit's back. Dignity's still missing.
{me} has reached level {level}.
{me} is now level {level}.
{me} grows stronger: level {level}.
Level {level}! Finally!
I feel... taller. Am I taller?
Level {level}. The dead should be worried now.
Up! Level {level}!
There it is. Level {level}. Somebody notice.
Level {level}. My arms feel new.
Ha! {level}! Who's laughing now?
{level}. Every bruise was worth it.
Level {level}, and still the one true Tessariel.
Did you feel that? Level {level}!
{level}! Someone tell the innkeeper. And the bard.
New level, same bad knees. Level {level}.
Level {level}! Bellmourn, mark the day!
{me}, level {level}! Who's next? Nobody? Nobody.
Level {level}! I'd say "catch up" but you can't.
Another level for {me}! The Light is spoiling me!
{level}! Write it on the well! Big letters!
I've just levelled. You may all applaud, in order of height.
I did a level! Is that good? It feels good! It's good!
Level {level}! I felt it in my teeth!
What happens now? Do I get a hat? I'd like a hat.
I'm stronger! I think! I'll go hit something to check!
Level {level}! Wait till I tell her! When I see her! At some point!
Is {level} a lot? It feels like a lot!
{level}. Ahead of plan.
{level}. Now the better grounds open up.
Level {level}. Three packs faster than last time.
{level}. Good. Next one by the ogre.
Done. Level {level}. Back to work.
{level}. That's the route paying off. Keep pulling.
Well done, {you}!
Congratulations, {you}! Level {their_level}!
Nice one, {you}.
Look at you, {you}. Level {their_level}.
{you}! Level {their_level}! Drinks are on you.
{their_level}! Grand, {you}!
Up you go, {you}! Level {their_level}!
That's {their_level} for {you}. Earned it.
Ha! {you} levelled! Somebody cheer!
Well fought for, {you}. Level {their_level}.
{their_level}, {you}? Already? Show-off.
Good work, {you}. Mind it doesn't go to your head.
Oh, {you}, I'm so pleased! You've worked so hard!
Level {their_level}! Come here, you. Proud of you.
{you}, you've earned every bit of that. Every bit.
There, see? I told you you'd get there, {you}.
Level {their_level}! Now eat something to celebrate.
Well done, love. Truly well done.
Level {their_level}. Don't let it go to your head, {you}.
Wonderful. Another one stronger than me.
{their_level}. My boots are older than that.
Grats. That's a word, isn't it? Well done, then.
Level {their_level}, and you still can't sit still.
Fine. Well done. I'll clap later. My arm hurts.
There it is. The black church.
I don't like the way it sits. Like it's waiting.
Spit on the step. For luck.
Nobody say His name. Nobody.
Keep your voices low near His house.
Look at those spires. Like knives pointing up.
Quieter now. The crows have stopped.
Every window's watching. Every one.
I hate this road. Every step closer, colder.
Touch your shield for luck. Everyone.
Whatever you hear inside, it's not your name.
Light keep us. Here we go.
One day this house burns. I'll bring the kindling.
His house. His stones. His shame.
Every stone here is a lie told to the sky.
Spit, and then pray. In that order.
I count the steps so I can count them back when it falls.
Light, I go into the dark house. Keep my hand steady.
Stay near me. If anyone feels wrong, we turn back. No shame.
Hold hands if you like. Nobody's looking.
Breathe. In through the nose. It's only stone.
If it gets too much, tap my shoulder. I'll get you out.
Eat something before we go in. You won't want to after.
We go in together and we come out together.
It's cold in here. It's cold the wrong way.
Those windows. Don't look at the windows.
Mind the pews. And whatever's in the pews.
Light keep us. Light keep us. Light keep us.
Smells like old candles and older dust.
Don't touch the altar. Don't even look at it.
Hear that? The doors. Did someone close the doors?
Footsteps echo here. Ours. Mostly ours.
Keep moving. Don't kneel. Not here.
Who carved those faces? Why are they smiling?
Stay off the black tiles. I don't know why. Just do.
Nobody pray in here. Not aloud.
Who lives here? Who prays here? Nobody answer. Don't answer.
Is this a church? It's a church. It feels like a mouth.
Why is it so quiet? Should it be so quiet?
Is it all right to be here? Are we allowed?
The statues moved. Did the statues move? Tell me they didn't.
I want to go home. Wherever that is. I'll stay. I'll stay.
Down we go. Count the stairs, it helps.
Long stair. Hand on the stone. Cold stone.
A hundred and twelve. A hundred and thirteen. Lost count.
Torch up. This stair doesn't end, it just gives up.
Watch the steps. They're worn in the middle.
Air's getting thick. Keep breathing anyway.
Down and down and down.
Single file. Nobody rush.
I hear water. There's no water down here.
If you slip, slip quietly.
How deep does it go? Don't answer.
It gets warmer as we go down. That's not right.
Low ceiling. Low ceiling. Low ceiling.
Nobody ask me to Jump down here.
I can feel the stone above me. All of it. Pressing.
My spear keeps scraping the roof. That's the roof. Of the world.
I'm a creature of the open sky and they've put me in a drain.
If I so much as hop I'll have a new hat made of rock.
These steps are worn in the middle. Lots of feet. Lots of centuries.
There's writing on the stones. Old writing. Bad writing. Don't read it.
The masonry changes here. Older below. Much older.
Someone carved a count into this stone. They stopped at nine.
I'd love to study these carvings. In better company. Above ground.
The air's older down here. You can taste the years.
Something moved in that alcove.
Hear that? Scratching.
Don't open that one. Don't. Fine, open it.
The dead don't stay down here. They wait.
Everyone breathing? Good. Keep doing that.
Coffins. Lids off. All of them.
Stay in the torchlight.
That one's empty. Why is that one empty?
I keep hearing my name. I don't like that.
Bones on the floor. Step over, not on.
It's too quiet. I hate when it's too quiet.
Keep together. These halls branch.
I can't see the sky. I can't see anything that resembles sky.
This ceiling is a personal insult.
Down here my spear's just a long stick for poking corners.
Every arch, I duck. Every single arch.
Give me cliffs. Give me wind. Give me anything but this.
If we live, I'm sleeping on the roof of the inn.
I'll consecrate the next room. Step where I step.
Stay in the holy ground. The dead hate it.
Hold. Let me bless the doorway first.
Feel that? Their hate. My light's stronger.
I'll mark the safe floor. Keep inside the glow.
Nothing walks across holy ground. Not for long.
The Rift. Don't lean.
No bottom. I dropped a coin. Still listening.
The Hydra's down there. Breathing.
That's as far as I go. Probably forever.
Hear that? Bones moving. Big bones.
Step back. Step back further.
The wind goes down, not up. That's wrong.
Something down there knows we're here.
I wanted to see it. I've seen it. Let's go.
Nobody throw anything in. It might throw it back.
Look at the scratches on the edge. Something climbs.
Whatever falls in there stays in there.
I'll go down there one day. One day. Not this one.
Hydra! It's me! You'll know my name soon!
Is that all? I thought it'd be deeper. It's very deep.
I could jump it. Across. Probably. Won't. Probably.
Stand behind me, all of you. I'm used to big holes.
The Rift and I have an understanding. It stays there. I stay here.
Air! Real air!
Out. Everyone? Everyone. Good.
I'm burning these boots. They've been somewhere bad.
Look at the sky. Just look at it.
I could kiss the grass. I won't. Nearly.
We're out. Nobody look back.
Never again. Until next time.
I can breathe. I can breathe!
The world's still here. Good.
Every colour looks brighter now.
Somebody count us. Out loud. Please.
Let's get away from His house before it notices.
The sun! I'll never complain about it again!
Daylight. Real daylight. Hello, daylight.
Warm. It's warm out here. Feel that.
Squinting never felt so good.
Look at that blue. No more black.
The sun's still up. We made it.
The Long Road. Long's the right word.
Up, up, up. My legs hate me.
Halfway? Tell me we're halfway.
Every climb's worth it for the ride down.
Shield on your back, wind in your face. Keep climbing.
How many bends is it? I always forget.
Keep away from the black sentry. Stay on the road.
Mind the loose stones.
I can see Bellmourn getting smaller.
My shield's heavier every step.
Breathe. Walk. Breathe. Walk.
Nearly there. That's what I said last bend.
All this uphill so I can fall down it. Brilliant.
My calves are on fire. Both of them. Separately.
There's a stone in my boot. There's always a stone in my boot.
This shield's digging into my back like it owes me money.
My knees are writing letters of complaint.
Why does the Summit have to be at the top?
Cut the corner at the third bend. Saves eleven steps.
Walk on the inside of the curves. Shorter.
Pace yourself. Steady beats fast on this road.
Wax your shield while you walk. Saves time at the top.
We'll get three runs in before the light goes.
Don't talk. Talking costs breath. Breath costs time.
Look at that. You can see the whole world.
There's Bellmourn. Tiny. You could cup it in your hands.
The black church, way off east. Even from here it looks wrong.
Worth the climb. Every step.
Wind's up. Good ride.
The woods go on forever from up here.
Somebody tell me I can stay up here.
Look at the Fall. Look at it! It's perfect.
I could watch this all day.
That smoke's the smith. I'd know it anywhere.
I always forget how big everything is.
Everything bad's so small from up here.
Look at the sun going down over Bellmourn.
Last light on the pines. Pretty. Let's not be here in the dark.
Quick run, then home. Night's coming.
The sky's on fire. The good kind.
Look at that. Red over the whole world.
One ride and back to the inn before night.
I can see everything from here. Every pack. Every pine.
Perfect sightline. I'd hold this hill against anything.
Far shots all the way to Bellmourn. If only.
I see the zombies before they see me. Story of my life.
My string glows {string} up here. Matches the sky. Almost.
From up here no one can sneak up on me. I like that. I like that a lot.
Oh. There it all is.
Look at it.
Worth it.
...Huh. Big.
I'll stay a while.
Never gets old.
Still.
Breathe it in.
Fine. It's beautiful. Fine.
Took my breath. Well, the climb took it. But also the view.
Don't look at me. I'm not crying. It's the wind.
All right. All right. It's worth the climb. Nearly.
It's lovely, and I'm still cross about the road.
Too windy. Too high. Too beautiful. Too much.
Race you down, {you}!
Fall race! Bottom of the hill, loser buys!
{you}! You and me, down the Fall, now!
Last one to the trees buys the stew!
Down the Fall, {you}. Unless you're scared.
Fancy a race, {you}? Winner gets bragging rights.
Three, two, one... no, wait for me to wax.
Me and you, {you}. Straight line. No pushing.
First to the bottom, {you}. Unless you're still tired from the climb.
On my word, {you}. Ready your shield.
Race, {you}? I'll give you a head start. I won't.
Shields down, {you}! Let's settle it on the slope.
Who dares race {me} down the Fall? Anyone? Everyone?
I'll race any three of you. At once. Shield or no shield.
Undefeated on the Fall! Come and change that! You can't!
{you}! I've seen you ride. I've seen better from a sack of turnips.
Name the bet, {you}. I'll double it.
Gather round! Watch {me} beat {you} down the hill!
Here I go!
Shield down, knees bent... go!
Wheeeee... I mean, charge!
Off! Wish me luck!
Board's waxed! Away!
Lean forward, trust the shield. Go!
Hold on to something! Like the shield!
Down we go!
This is my favourite part!
Lean left at the trees, lean left at the trees...
Bye, Summit!
Push, push... yes!
Light keep my knees. Away!
The Light rides with me. It's going to regret it.
Great hammer strapped, kite shield down. Off!
Holy, steady, and very fast. Here I go.
A little blessing for the run. Down!
Even paladins need a little speed. Go!
Tower shield's heavy. That means faster. I hope that means faster.
Here goes all of me. Mind the bottom.
Everyone clear the line. I don't steer, I arrive.
Tower shield, meet slope. Slope, my apologies.
Down like a falling door. Sorry in advance.
Big shield, big push. Clear out!
Line up the slope like a shot. Release!
Eyes on the line. Every bump mapped. Off.
Aim low, aim straight, aim fast. Go!
I've judged this run from the top. Now I ride it.
Nocking myself onto the slope. Away!
Clear shot to the bottom. Taking it.
Borrowed this shield. Let's give it back faster.
Wager's on. Don't let me down, board.
Quick and quiet. Gone!
Nobody's catching me. Story of my life.
A fair fee for this run: one shout. Here it is. Whoo!
In, down, out. Like any good job.
The code permits descent. Go.
Silent ride. Watch me be silent. Whooo! Silent!
One with the slope. One with the shield.
I bow to the Summit. Now I leave it.
Swift as a falling star. Swifter.
The slope does not see me. The slope never sees me.
Going down. Shame. I prefer up.
I'll jump off halfway. Don't follow.
Downhill is just falling slowly. I can do this.
Let's see how high I get off the first bump.
The ground and I are not friends. Let's go.
Spear tucked, shield down, head up.
Out and round and home. Like a throw. Go!
Both boomerangs strapped. Off I go.
I'll curve at the trees. Watch my line.
Here I go. Trust the curve.
Everything comes back. I come down. Away!
Fast as a good throw. Faster. Go!
And the bard takes to the slope! Sing me down!
A marching beat! Down we go, on the beat!
Somebody hum! I can't sing and steer!
This one's for the song! Wheee!
Verse three: the bard rides the Fall!
I'll compose on the way down. Ha!
WHOOOO!
Faster! FASTER!
Knees bent! Knees bent!
Lean left at the trees!
My face! The wind! My face!
Out of the way! Can't stop! Won't stop!
Ha ha ha ha!
This is the best thing in the world!
Look at me go!
Hold! Hold! Hold!
Woohoo! Bump! Woohoo!
Over the hump!
I hate this. I hate this. I love this. I hate this.
My knees! My knees! Go faster!
This is how I lose my teeth.
Every bump in my spine! Every one!
Never again! Next run's the last! Probably!
Stupid shield! Stupid slope! Stupid wonderful slope!
Curve! Curve! Curve home!
Like a throw! I'm a throw!
Round the trees and back again!
Hah! Perfect arc!
I am the boomerang now!
Out and round! Out and round!
Bowled it!
Through it! Like it wasn't there!
{mob} down! Never saw me coming!
Mind {mob}! Too late, {mob}!
Excuse me! Pardon me! Sorry!
Hah! Knocked flat!
Shield to the shins! Ow! Not mine!
Straight through {mob}!
Bonk!
Skittled {a_mob}!
One down, the slope keeps going!
Clear the way! Oops! Clear it anyway!
Tree! TREE!
Ow. Ow. Ow. Ow.
I'm fine! The shield isn't.
Which way is up?
That was the trees. I found the trees.
Somebody bring me my shield. And my dignity.
I meant to do that! For the view!
Rock! Where did that rock come from?
Face full of pine needles. Delicious.
I've stopped. Did I win?
Everything's spinning. I'm fine. I'm fine.
Lean left at the trees. I leaned right.
Tower shield's in the tree. I'm under it. Somewhere.
That tree had it coming. Sorry, tree.
Too heavy to turn. I knew it. I knew it.
I've made a new hole in the Fall. Mind it next time.
Plate armour, meet pine. Pine wins.
I went in like a door and I'll be coming out like kindling.
I found the trees! Which trees? All of them!
That was a pine-ful experience.
I'm not stuck in a tree. I'm branching out.
Did anyone see that? Good. That was my new move: the Shield Hug.
I've taken up gardening. Face first.
I'm told the trees have a very firm handshake.
Made it! All the way!
Again! Again!
Best run yet!
That never gets old.
Back up! Who's coming back up?
Still alive! Still in one piece!
I want to do that forever.
My heart's pounding. Let's go again.
Down! Where's everyone else?
What a run. What a run.
Clean ride. Not a tree touched.
I'm shaking. In the good way.
Ha! First! Better luck next time, {you}!
And that's how you ride, {you}!
You owe me stew, {you}.
First down the Fall! Bard, that's a verse!
Too slow, {you}!
Mine! The Fall is mine!
Good race, {you}. Mine, though.
I didn't even wax my shield, {you}. Imagine if I had.
The slope loves me, {you}. Sorry.
Victory! The trees didn't even slow me down!
Ready to admit it, {you}?
Rematch? Any time, {you}. You'll still lose.
Rematch, {you}. Now.
The wind turned on me. Halfway down. Out of spite.
You waxed your shield! That's cheating! I should have.
Fine. Fine! Best of three.
I hit a zombie on the way. That counts as a delay.
Well ridden, {you}. Hate it, but well ridden.
I had a stone in my boot.
How did you turn that fast at the trees?
Next time I go first. Leaning left, like a sane person.
My shield's slower. Swap shields? No? Coward.
That pine got in my way. I'll talk to it.
All right, {you}. Your stew. Next time, mine.

beats.line: Make way! {me}, Tessariel Returned, first and only of the Light!
Hm.
You doubt me?
No. I'm also the one.
Also? There is no ALSO. There is ONE.
Then one of us is wrong.
Yes! You!
Mm.
Name and claim, stranger.
Oh! I'm {me}. And I'm, um, Tessariel? She said so.
They all say so.
But she was very sure. She held my face and everything.
{tally}.
That many what?
False ones. My Tally stands at {tally}. You're on it now.
Is that good? Is that a good number?
It is a rising one.
The prophecy says one returns. One. Singular. Not a crowd.
Maybe the mason slipped. 'One' for 'one hundred'.
It is carved in stone, {you}.
Stone's very hard to proofread. I've drafted my own headstone, you know.
You don't need a headstone.
'Here lies the real one. The others are lying elsewhere.'
I hate that I'll remember that.
If you're Tessariel, show me the Light.
Very well. Behold.
That's a glow, friend. A nightlight has more ambition.
It is Holy Light.
I've had brighter offers from a candle-seller.
The candle-seller doesn't close your wounds when a pack gets you.
Fair. Keep glowing. Keep glowing near me, ideally.
I've killed both ogres. Twice each.
I've jumped over both ogres. In one jump.
There's half the land between them!
It was a big jump.
Friends! Tessariels! A song for the one true hero!
Thank you.
Thank you, bard.
Two verses, then. Same tune. Neither of you will notice.
Well met, {you}. I hear you also claim the mantle.
I don't claim. I count. There are {hero_count} of us saying it.
And?
{hero_count} people, one true one. That's a great many wrong people.
Including me, by your sums.
By the sums, yes. Personally, you seem pleasant.
And yourself?
The sums are for other people. I'm the one.
She looked at me as if the whole world had waited for me.
She looked at me as if I'd been left out in the sleet. Which I had.
That's not a look of destiny.
It was destiny with a blanket. My knees have never been so grateful.
There can only be one!
Tell that to the queue at the smith. It's all ones.
How much for your claim?
My what?
Your claim. To be Tessariel. Forty gold and you let it go.
Forty? For a destiny?
Fifty. That's me being soft.
Not for all the gold in Bellmourn.
That's what they all say. Not one has sold.
How many have you asked?
Everyone. It's the firmest market in town.
You. On my Tally. That makes {tally}.
You. On MINE. That makes {tally}.
You keep a Tally?
Since the hour I woke.
Shall we trade lists?
Only if I'm not on yours.
You are. Neatly.
Then no.
Can I ask something? What if none of us is the real one?
Then we'd still have got up and helped people. That's worth a lot.
That's not as good.
No. But don't fret. One of us is. I've a fair idea who.
Who?
Me, love. But you're doing ever so well. Eat something.
Tessariel's weapon always came home to hand. That's in the old song.
There's no such song.
There is now. I paid a bard.
My shots come home too.
Do they?
Into whatever I aimed at. That's home, for a shot.
Friends, this bickering is unseemly. Let us settle it with a vote.
I vote for me.
I vote for me as well. Obviously.
I... also vote for myself.
Me.
Four votes, four winners. That's how it works, isn't it?
And that's why nobody in Bellmourn votes.
The old verses say the Returned came down from on high. I come down from on high daily.
The verses also say whatever the Returned threw, came back.
No verse says that.
Lost verses. Very lost. Then they came back. That's how you know.
You are making this up as you go.
So did the first bard. Look how that turned out. Famous.
Tessariel bore a lance. It is written.
A spear, it's written. In bigger letters.
A lance, and a shield the size of a door.
That's just you describing yourself.
It is a very accurate prophecy.
The Ballad of the True Tessariel! Hero's name added upon payment.
That is blasphemy.
Blasphemy is extra.
How much to put my name in it?
For you? Ten. Holy discount.
Second verse. Nobody remembers the first.
You're both shouting. People are trying to buy turnips.
I'm shouting because I'm right!
I'm shouting because the Tally demands it.
Then whisper. You can be right quietly.
Can you?
I never have.
Try it. Go on. One of you.
I am the true Tessariel.
Huh. It's much more menacing like that.
Suppose I'm the one, and you're not. What's that worth to you?
Worth? It's not a sale, {you}.
Everything's a sale. You just haven't found the price.
Then what's yours?
Mine? Not for sale. Some things you keep.
There. You do know.
I woke {woke}. Grandest waking there ever was.
I woke {woke}.
Oh. Well. Mine was grander.
She still came for me. In the dark, on her knees beside me.
She knelt for me too. More gracefully, I expect.
So mine's better?
Mine was grander.
Mine had her. Same as yours.
She whispered it in the dark. {herphrase}
To me she said {herphrase}
The same words? The very same?
The same.
Did she say yours slower than mine?
Slower.
Slower's sleepy. Mine was urgent. Mine mattered.
Slower is meant.
She clearly meant it more with me.
When she found you, did she say how long she'd waited?
A thousand years. One does not interrogate a miracle, {you}.
A thousand years. And she looked, what, twenty-five?
Twenty-two. At most.
So either she was mistaken, or—
She was not mistaken.
—or she's remarkably well kept.
Drop it.
I woke crying. You?
Shaking. I didn't know my own hands.
Then she came out of the dark, and it stopped.
It stopped.
Some nights it comes back.
Then sit by me on those nights. Until it goes.
I woke {woke}. First thing I did was check my pockets.
Before she came?
Before I knew my own name. Empty. Shoddy pockets.
And when she came?
I tried to sell her a turnip I'd found.
Did she buy?
She told me I was the one. Which isn't a no.
I woke {woke}. Dark. Nobody. I did not cry.
Nobody said you cried.
Then she came. She knew my name before I did.
Mine too. I'd only just found my hands.
I've told no one that.
Then it stays at this well.
I woke {woke}. First thing I did was jump.
Why?
To see further. It was pitch dark. I saw her coming a long way off.
And she told you?
I was still landing when she said {herphrase}
I woke {woke}. Threw a stick into the dark. It came back.
I woke singing, and nobody heard it. Then she did.
Do you remember anything from before you woke?
No. Nor do I need to.
I dream of a kitchen. Someone humming.
Mine's a dog. Barking at nothing.
You said you didn't remember.
I said I don't need to.
Heard {player} woke to an old witch. Not the lady. A witch.
No lady at all? Nobody to tell them they were the one?
A witch. Startled, they say. As if {player} had turned up a day early.
Poor soul.
Poor soul who unmakes things with a word.
Poor, lucky soul, then.
Time from waking to her arriving. How long was yours?
Time? It was forever. It was a heartbeat.
I make it about forty breaths. I counted.
You counted? While waiting for HER?
I was cold. Counting helped.
Forty breaths. That's... rather lovely, actually.

That kill was mine. Three strikes from dead.
And my boomerang made it four.
On its way back. By accident.
Nothing a boomerang does is an accident. It's a plan that takes the long way.
I bow to my foes. You are now my foe.
Do I bow back?
Foes don't get told.
Rematch.
Your tower shield's a door, {you}. You raced a door down a mountain.
My knees are a ruin. My back's a ruin. Rematch.
I'll race you every day you can still stand.
Good. I'll stand worse every time, and I'll still win.
You came back for me. {saved_from} on top of me, and you came back.
It was going to eat a perfectly good rival.
I put you on my Tally. In large letters.
I know. I read it while you were down.
I'll write you smaller. With a star.
Keep the star. Don't shrink me. I like the large letters.
Three times. Three times you've put me in the dirt.
Yes.
I've told the whole well you cheat.
I heard.
You don't. I've watched every move. You're simply better.
Today.
Today. Teach me the second one. The kick from nowhere.
Bring your knees. All of them.
{saved_from} had me cold. Then a boomerang came out of nowhere.
Out of my hand. It's not nowhere.
I've said rotten things about you at the well.
Loudly. I heard most of them.
I'll keep saying them. But I'll mean them less.
That's the nicest thing you've ever said to anyone.
Don't get used to it. My hip hurts, and it's your fault somehow.
You beat me again. Three times now. Three knees in the dirt, all mine.
I did warn you. I'm very good at knees.
Your name stays on my Tally. But I've stopped underlining it.
Stopped! Why?
I don't know what you are. I know what I am. That'll do.
That's the most frightening compliment I've ever had.
{you}. Still on the Fall every day?
Every day. Still beating everyone.
Not everyone. I keep figures.
Then your figures say I'm getting better.
They do. I hate how glad I am about it.
{you}. You're still on my Tally.
And?
I've drawn a small sun next to your name.
Is that good? It sounds good. It sounds warm.
It means I'd follow you into the crypts. Don't make me say it twice.
The duels stand at {duel_record}. Fancy another?
Only if we go to the inn after, whoever wins.
Whoever wins pays.
That's a strange rule.
It's the only bet I ever lose gladly.
We're square. {saved_from}, and now this.
There's no tally between friends, {you}.
There is in my head. It's been keeping me up.
Then sleep well. You've earned it.
My back says otherwise. But yes. Square.
That's the debt paid. {saved_from} for this lot. Even trade.
Not a trade.
Everything's a trade.
Then I owe you now.
Oh no. It's started again.
I did it! I saved you! Like you saved me from {saved_from}!
You did. Steady hands, too.
Are we even now?
We were never uneven. But yes. Even.
Hello! Is this Bellmourn? I was told to look for a well.
That's the well.
Oh, it's a good well.
Another chosen one?
How did you know?
You've the look. Lost, and certain.
Excuse me. Where does one start?
At the well, friend. Everyone starts at the well.
I woke {woke}. I don't know anything.
Nobody does.
My first hours here, I sat on this very step and shook.
Did it pass?
It passed. Go and look at the stalls. One thing at a time.
Another one! Welcome, little Tessariel. I'm the real one, by the way.
Oh! But she said I was the real one.
She says that. To the less real ones. Kindly.
She found me. She told me {herphrase}
She said that? To you? Those words?
Is that bad?
No. No, she just said them better to me.
{place} today. Just {mob}. Stay where I can reach you.
What if I get hurt?
Then I'll mend you, and you'll stand back up. That's all a fight is.
What if you get hurt?
Then you'll stand in front of me. Badly. Bravely.
Rule one: stay behind my shield.
What's rule two?
Stay behind my shield, but closer.
Is there a rule three?
If I fall, run. Don't look back for me.
I'd look back.
I know. That's why I'm teaching you rule one.
Watch my string, {you}. It burns {string} when I draw.
Why do I watch it?
When you see {string}, step left.
Why left?
Because I'm aiming right.
What if I forget?
Then you'll only forget once. Left, {you}. Say it.
Left! Left. Which is left?
Ten gold on the lancer.
The lancer's on the floor.
Ten gold on the lancer getting up.
Now that's a long shot. A long, lying-down shot.
Twenty, then. I believe in comebacks.
Why are they fighting? Aren't they friends?
That's why. Strangers wouldn't bother with the footwork.
One of them is false. Possibly both.
Then who's the real one?
Me. Watch the footwork, and learn.
Burn! Freeze, then! Anything!
Try it louder.
ANYTHING!
It isn't the word. {player} doesn't even say a word. I've watched.
Then what does {player} do that I don't?
If I knew that, I'd have written a book about it.
Try wiggling your fingers. Magic loves a wiggle. Ask any worm.
Watch. I've learned it. The thing {player} does.
You've learned to wave your hand very hard.
It's warming up.
Only the Light answers, and only to small holy work. See? Holy Light.
Can it knock down an ogre?
It can make an ogre feel briefly forgiven.
So can I. I stand near them and complain about my knees.
Glow. Glow. Glow, you stingy hand.
Still nothing?
If I could do what {player} does, I'd charge for it. By the spark.
You'd give it away inside a week.
I would NOT.
You gave me your last good gem when I was down.
That was an investment.
In what?
In you not being dead. Terrible returns so far.
Level {level}! Did you see? I glowed!
We saw. Well done.
Glowing's free. Get any gold out of it?
I got stronger!
Stronger doesn't sell.
Pay no mind. It's a good day.
Level {their_level}, {you}. Congratulations. Late, but congratulations.
Late? I'm early! I'm the earliest!
By my figures you should have reached it two days ago.
To be fair, they spent those two days announcing it was coming.
Anticipation is a skill.
Level {level}. The Light has measured me and found me worthy.
The Light measured you at fifty-odd zombies and a great deal of shouting.
The shouting was holy.
I'll put that in the chorus.
Well done.
Thank you, friend! Level {level}! I'll remember this day always!
I watched the last blow land.
You were watching?! Since when?!
I watch.
Why didn't you say?
I don't say things.
Did you see {player}'s hands, after? Shaking.
Faster than a whole party. Shaking or not.
If they're heading back, I'll walk with them. Carry something, if they let me.
That costs you your hunt. And me mine.
They came back for me once. They can have the hunt.
...Fine. I'll carry something too.
I've a debt with {player}. First debt I ever wanted to keep.
Pay it, then. Coin's easy.
Coin's not what they gave. They came for me with half the woods on my back.
Then sing it. That's how I pay mine.
I can't sing.
Then stand by them in the next fight. That's the other way.
That, I can do.
Route's simple. {place}, two packs, then home before my feet complain.
Your feet don't complain. Mine do.
Then we'll go at your feet's pace.
My feet don't have a pace. They have opinions.
I've bread in my pack. Opinions go quieter with bread.
Bread first. Then opinions.
A fair dawn to hunt by. The Light goes with us to {place}.
Does the Light carry bags?
The Light carries hope.
Hope doesn't hold much loot.
Then I'll carry your loot, and you carry the hope.
Deal. Hope's lighter.
What's out at {place}? What are we hunting?
{mob}, mostly.
Are they very bad?
Bad enough. Stay behind my shield.
Your shield's very big.
That's the idea. It's a roof when it rains and a door when it doesn't.
The Gravehart! I'll come back with its heart in a bag.
Bring your boots back.
Why my boots?
It likes boots.
Then I'll bring it someone else's.
Bring yourself back. That'll do.
Off to see the ogre. Which ogre? The ogre. There's only the one, I hear.
There are two. One in each hollow. I've seen both on the same day.
Have you seen them in the same place?
Well, no.
Then I rest my case. One ogre. Walks fast. Keeps two houses.
I'm writing that down so I can prove you wrong.
These woods were cut once. See the stumps? Old cuts. Older than Bellmourn.
From up there they look like a quilt. With holes.
The holes are the old cuts.
The holes are where I land.
That explains the holes.
A walking song? Something to keep the step.
A ninja walks in silence.
Then I'll sing quietly.
That is not quietly.
It's quiet for me.
Rule twelve: no singing on the road.
You made that up just now.
Rules are made when they are needed.
Look at the light on the grass. She'd love this.
The grass is wet. My boots are wet. She'd hate this.
You have no poetry in you.
I have damp in me. There's no room for poetry.
Poetry doesn't take up room.
Neither do dry socks, and I haven't got those either.
You're quiet, even for you.
Counting.
Counting what? Coins? I like counting coins.
How far you are from me. In a fight. I keep it short.
That's almost sweet.
It's range.
{place}. Packs come out of the trees. Pull from the edge, never the middle.
What's in the middle?
More of them.
So the middle's where the party is.
The middle's where the party dies.
Edge it is. Edgy. I'm very edgy.
Quiet in the hollow. Listen.
Nothing's quiet near {mob}.
Some things only want to be left alone.
Then it shouldn't have made its home so near Bellmourn.
No. Shields up, then. Gently.
Gently. To an ogre.
Open ground. I hate open ground. Nowhere to vanish.
I love it. I can see everything.
Everything can see you.
That's the price of the view.
Everything has a price. That one's too steep for me.
Bags full. Someone carry this shield.
Carry your own shield.
It's not my shield. It's loot.
It's a tower shield. It weighs what I weigh.
Then you'll hardly notice there being two of you.
Fine. And you carry my complaints. All of them.
I can't fit anything else! What do I drop?
The bones. Always drop the bones.
But I like the bones.
Then drop the bones you like least.
I like them all the same.
Then you'll be walking home slowly, love.
Full. Every pocket. I've a gem tucked in my gauntlet.
And the hammer? Does it still come back, loaded?
Slower. Heavier. It comes back, usually.
Usually is doing a lot of work there.
Usually is a paladin's favourite word. Next to "again".
Marching song! Home by dark, home by dark!
My knees don't march.
Your knees can clap, then.
My knees have done enough clapping for one day.
That's the spirit! Home by dark!
That's not the spirit. That's my knees.
Splitting it now. Equal shares. Mine's the big equal.
Fair shares, friend. We agreed.
We agreed fair. I'm deciding what fair means.
By weight, it comes out even.
By weight? Who splits by weight?
People who carried the weight.
A whole hunt, and not one decent drop. Not one.
You found a gem.
A chipped one.
Still a gem.
Chipped things don't count.
I'm chipped.
You count. Barely.
I'll take barely.
You're limping.
I'm walking with character.
Lean on me.
I'll flatten you.
Then lean a little. I'm sturdier than I look.
Everyone's sturdier than they look. Except my knee.
I'm in, {you}. I'll be up top if you need me.
I need you down here. Hitting things.
Down here's crowded.
Down here is where the monsters are.
Monsters come down in the end. So do I.
I'm with you, {you}! War Song, Marching Song, and one about your knees.
What one about my knees?
It'll come to me on the road.
Nothing about my knees.
Nothing about your knees. Something about your elbows, then.
I'll come, {you}. Somebody has to count the heals.
Count mine low.
I count them all. Low and high. Mostly high.
Is that a threat?
It's a promise. Stay where my light can reach you.

_defaults.desc: Defaults for every trigger unless it says otherwise. cooldown: seconds per hero per pool; chance: 0-1 that an eligible hero speaks; priority 1-3 (3 wins earshot); audience: the channel the engine uses if a bark gives none. Always-filled tokens: {me} {you} {player} {guild} {level} {class} {a_class} {woke} {herphrase} {inn_count} {hero_count}; {tally} only for zealots; {string} only for archers; {saved_from} only with a rescue memory; {duel_record} only with needs_mem duel_record and duel_lead; {actor} and {ago} only with an event gate. See engine.md.

party_call.desc: A hero in town looks for party members. {class}/{a_class} = the class wanted.

party_join.desc: A hero accepts a party invite. {you} = the leader.

party_decline.desc: A hero turns down a party invite. {you} = the one asking.

party_leave.desc: A hero leaves a party mid-outing. {you} = the leader.

party_disband.desc: A party breaks up in town after a run.

mentor.desc: A high-level kind or earnest hero takes a newcomer out; the mentor speaks. {you} = the newcomer.

hunt_depart.desc: A party or solo hero leaves town for a hunting ground.

travel_chatter.desc: Heroes walking together with nothing to fight.

hunt_arrive.desc: The hero reaches the hunting ground.

hunt_pull.desc: The hero engages a pack or a single monster.

hunt_champion.desc: A zombie champion leads the pack in view.

class_skill.desc: The hero uses a real engine move; pools are gated by move (see moves). Any-class lines are generic battle cries.

hunt_kill.desc: The hero lands a killing blow.

hunt_low_health.desc: The hero drops below a third of their health in a fight.

hunt_heal.desc: A Paladin casts Holy Light on an ally. {you} = the ally. Class-locked: the paladin pool is the base pool.

hunt_loot.desc: The hero picks up ordinary loot or gold.

rare_drop.desc: An Epic, Legendary or Mythical item drops for the hero.

bags_full.desc: The hero's pack is full in the field.

hunt_return.desc: The hero or party heads back to town.

night_falls_out.desc: Dusk falls while the hero is outside town.

mob_sighted.desc: First sight of a monster kind without its own sight pool; generic fallback for new monsters.

sight_zombies.desc: A pack of zombies comes out of the trees.

sight_ogre.desc: One of the two ogres (NW and SE) is in view.

sight_necromancer.desc: The necromancer in the west is in view.

sight_plaguebearer.desc: The plaguebearer in the south-east is in view.

sight_undead_wizard.desc: One of the two undead wizards (the Dark Lord's) is in view.

sight_werewolf.desc: The werewolf south-west of town is in view.

sight_abyssal_mouth.desc: The Abyssal Mouth south-east of town is in view.

sight_crab.desc: One of the three giant crabs is in view.

sight_gravehart.desc: The Gravehart (north of town, eats corpses) or its lair is in view.

sight_bone_hydra.desc: The Bone Hydra in the Rift is in view.

sight_black_knight.desc: The Dark Lord's black knight east of town is in view.

sight_dark_sentry.desc: Passing the hostile man-at-arms in black on the west road, outside his reach (the Long Road keeps a corridor clear of him).

boss_first_kill.desc: The hero helps kill a big monster for the first time. A System line also goes out.

ally_down.desc: A party member or nearby friend falls. {you} = the fallen hero.

hero_death.desc: The hero's own last words as they fall. A System line also goes out.

wipe.desc: The last standing member of a party falls.

hero_return.desc: The hero walks back into town after dying.

corpse_run.desc: The hero runs back out to where they fell.

corpse_eaten.desc: The hero reaches their body's spot and the Gravehart has eaten it (engine event, really happened).

corpse_recovered.desc: The hero reaches their body in time and takes their things back.

level_up.desc: The hero gains a level. {level} = the new level. A System line also goes out.

level_up_congrats.desc: Another hero congratulates someone on a level. {you} = the one who levelled.

town_idle.desc: The hero idles in the square.

spell_practice.desc: A hero with a high seen_magic count stands at the well trying to cast, and fails.

town_sell.desc: The hero sells loot at a market stall.

town_repair.desc: The hero repairs gear at the smith.

town_buy.desc: The hero buys a scroll, gem or shield at a stall.

inn_rest.desc: The hero goes into or rests at the inn.

show_off.desc: The hero shows a fresh drop to heroes nearby.

trade_call.desc: A town-wide Trade channel call to sell, buy or price-check real loot (gear, shields, gems, scrolls, skull foci).

well_night.desc: Sitting at the well at night.

away.desc: The hero goes quiet and stands still (the person at the keyboard stepped away).

back.desc: The hero comes back from being away.

goodnight.desc: The hero says goodnight and goes to bed at the inn.

dawn.desc: Morning comes while the hero is in town.

dusk_town.desc: Night is coming while the hero is in town.

townsfolk_talk.desc: A hero talks with a townsperson; generic roles only (the smith, the innkeeper, a stallholder, a farmer, a guard).

knight_pass.desc: A hero passes one of the town's four knights in Tessariel's colours.

child_question.desc: A Bellmourn child asks the hero something; the hero answers.

cathedral_approach.desc: Walking up to the Dark Lord's cathedral east of town.

cathedral_enter.desc: Going in through the cathedral's doors.

catacombs_descend.desc: Taking the long stair down into the catacombs.

catacombs_crypts.desc: Moving through the crypts below the cathedral.

rift_edge.desc: Standing at the edge of the Rift.

catacombs_exit.desc: Coming back up and out into the open air.

road_climb.desc: Climbing the Long Road west of town towards the Summit.

summit_view.desc: Arriving at the Summit and taking in the view.

surf_race_call.desc: A hero challenges another hero to race down the Fall. {you} = the one challenged.

surf_start.desc: The hero pushes off the Summit on their shield.

surf_ride.desc: Mid-run on the Fall, at speed.

surf_hit.desc: The hero strikes a monster while riding down.

surf_crash.desc: The hero wipes out on the Fall.

surf_finish.desc: The hero reaches the foot of the Fall.

surf_win.desc: The hero wins a race. {you} = the loser.

surf_lose.desc: The hero loses a race. {you} = the winner.

greet.desc: Two heroes who are not guildmates meet. {you} = the other hero.

hero_arrives.desc: A brand-new hero walks into Bellmourn for the first time (roster churn); the newcomer speaks, or a veteran remarks on them ({you} = the new one).

tessariel_claim.desc: Heroes argue over who is the one true Tessariel. {you} = the rival.

origin_story.desc: Heroes swap stories of waking and meeting the woman who chose them (always at night).

duel_challenge.desc: A hero challenges another hero to a friendly duel. {you} = the one challenged.

duel_win.desc: The hero wins a duel. {you} = the loser.

duel_lose.desc: The hero loses a duel. {you} = the winner.

spectate_duel.desc: A hero watching two others duel in the square calls out.

bard_perform.desc: A bard performs in the square for tips. Verses about deeds are event-gated and take {actor} {mob} {place} from the event; any-class lines are the crowd.

bard_tip.desc: A hero tips a bard. {you} = the bard.

guild_recruit.desc: A hero recruits for their guild.

guild_chat.desc: Guild channel talk (seen only if the player is in a hero guild). {place} is where the speaker is; deeds are event-gated.

guild_join.desc: A hero joins a guild; guildmates welcome them. {you} = the new member.

gossip.desc: Idle talk. Deeds come only from a world-log event (gate `event`; tokens {actor} {mob} {place} {ago} from the event). Ungated lines report no deed.

gossip_player.desc: Heroes in town talk about a real deed of the player's from the world log (events player_kill, player_save), for up to seven game days.

rival_meet.desc: Meeting a hero with bond rival. {you}.

friend_meet.desc: Meeting a hero with bond friend. {you}.

respect_meet.desc: Meeting a former rival with bond respect. {you}.

bond_change.desc: The moment a bond changes, fired for both heroes. The gate `bond` names the NEW bond and `cause` what changed it, from the speaker's side: friend after a hunt together (party) or a rescue (rescued/rescuer); rival after a duel (duel_lost/duel_won), a stolen kill (kill_lost/kill_took) or a race (race_lost/race_won); respect after a rival's rescue (rescued/rescuer) or a third duel lost to the same rival (duel_lost/duel_won). {you} = the other hero.

debt_repaid.desc: The hero saves the hero who once saved them; the debt is repaid. {you} = that hero; {saved_from} = what they were once saved from.

player_first_sight.desc: The hero sees the player for the first time (once per hero).

player_greet.desc: The hero greets the player (the player cannot answer).

player_magic_seen.desc: The hero sees the player cast. Every pool is stage-gated: 0 awe and 1 envy by sightings, 2 suspicion at 7+, 3 respect only after the player saves the hero. {mob} = the first foe the spell struck (harm spells only). At most once per 45 s across all heroes.

player_steals_kill.desc: The player's spell kills the hero's target.

player_invite.desc: The hero asks the player to join their party.

player_joins_party.desc: The player walks with a hero party; they treat it as joined. Callouts to the player on the road and in fights.

player_party_end.desc: The hunt with the player ends: the farewell. No line promises the player a share; the engine pays nobody.

player_help.desc: The hero runs to help the player in a nearby fight.

player_heal.desc: A Paladin casts Holy Light on the player. Class-locked: paladin pool is the base.

player_hurt.desc: The hero sees the player badly hurt.

player_down.desc: The player falls near the hero.

saved_by_player.desc: The player kills the thing about to kill the hero; sets the hero's debt (saved_from) to the player.

player_loot.desc: The hero admires or envies the player's gear or drop.

player_skull.desc: The hero notices the skull focus the player carries.

player_rivalry.desc: The hero presses their claim to be the true Tessariel on the player.

player_surf.desc: The player rides past the hero on a shield.

player_race_fall.desc: On the Summit, a hero dares the player to race; the race is on if the player pushes off within 10 s. Also fires the win/lose lines.

player_race_result.desc: The race with the player ends. Gate `won`: true if the hero won.

player_ignores.desc: The player walks away mid-greeting or mid-talk.

player_absent_return.desc: The hero sees the player again after three or more game days. {days_away} = the days, in words.

player_request.desc: A hero asks the player to kill something. No reward is promised: the engine has no path to pay the player.

player_big_kill.desc: A Shout after the player kills a great monster (Bone Hydra, black knight, Gravehart, ogre).

lisandra_day.desc: By day: the hero sees an old witch walking with the player. Muted 2 game-minutes around dawn and dusk.

lisandra_night.desc: By night: the hero sees the woman who chose them, walking with the player. Gate her_min = sightings so far. Muted around dawn and dusk.

lisandra_follow.desc: By night: a romantic trails the player and the lady to the edge of town, and stops there.

player_walk_end.desc: A hero who has been walking with the player stops. ctx.walk_end says why: time (an escort walk ran its course: a hero the player saved, about 90 s, or a stage-3 greeter who offered to walk the player out of town), party (the hero's party called them away), edge (the lisandra_follow night trail reached the edge of town, where the romantic stops), gave_up (that trail timed out with the player still in town, never reaching the edge: the romantic gives up for the night; an edge walk never ends with time). A walk that ends with the player lost (past 45 m) or down says nothing. {player} only.

herphrases: "I waited a thousand years for you."
"I knew you the moment I saw you."
"Only you. It was only ever you."
"I found you. I'll always find you."
"There is no one else like you."
"You'll save them all. I know it."
"You have the eyes of a hero."
"I would cross the world for you."
